publicStatus.title: Visibility
publicStatus.label: Make story public
publicStatus.description: Other users can experience this story when public

storySetting.title: Story Setting
storySetting.placeholder: Describe the story background, world rules, the user's identity, and the main objective. Example: Strange districts appear after midnight, and the user must investigate the rules and collect clues.

roles.title: Characters
roles.addFirst: Add a character to the list first.

sceneSetting.title: Scene Setting
sceneSetting.placeholder: Describe the time, place, atmosphere, and interactive clues. Example: An empty old station at dawn displays a route that does not exist.

outline.title: Plot Outline
outline.chapterDescription: Describe the main events and the user's interactions with other characters

generateModal.title: AI Generate
generateModal.description: How should AI expand your story?
generateModal.currentDescription: Expand only the section you selected.
generateModal.allDescription: Complete the story setting, scene, and outline in sequence.

overwrite.all: Generate All will regenerate and replace all existing content except the character list, including the story setting, scene setting, and plot outline.
overwrite.setting: Current Only will regenerate the story setting and may replace the title, introduction, setting, and background you entered.
overwrite.scene: Current Only will regenerate the scene setting and may replace the scene content you entered.
overwrite.outline: Current Only will regenerate the plot outline and may replace the outline you entered.

help.storyDescription: Briefly describe the story theme, world, or inciting event. AI will use it to create a richer plot outline and chapter details.
help.roleDescription: Choose or create characters for the story. The user participates as the protagonist, while other characters act as NPCs that move the plot forward.
help.sceneImageDescription: Tap the scene image area to open the background gallery. The selected image will be added to this story.
help.sceneDescription: Define the location and atmosphere. A clear scene helps AI create more vivid imagery and mood.
help.outlineDescription: The outline defines the overall progression of the story. Write it manually or let AI expand it from your existing settings.
